To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the SANC system is a unique tool to perform calculations in perturbative QCD and electroweak theory; (b) the SANC library contains a large number of processes and the library is growing; (c) the library is available for users; (d) the SANC is a unique tool for the precision calculations for the LHC and other experiments.

the SANC system provides a unified and flexible approach to calculations of the one-loop QCD corrections to a wide variety of processes in hadron-hadron, lepton-hadron, hadron-lepton, and lepton-lepton scattering.
the SANC system is a universal and flexible platform for calculations of high precision QCD theoretical predictions in various processes and reactions of particle physics.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following problems: 1) the calculation of the QCD radiative corrections to a wide class of processes of the high energy particle interactions at one-loop level; 2) the calculation of QCD corrections to the processes of the hadronic interactions at two-loop precision level; 3) the construction of the Monte-Carlo generator of QCD processes at the one-loop level.
the development of a new generation of theoretical predictions for high energy interactions of the fundamental particles at the next-to-next-to-leading order (NNLO) precision level.
the development of theoretical methods and algorithms for calculations of high precision QCD cross sections.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the SANC project is a very promising tool for precision calculations and phenomenological applications in the field of QCD and EW interactions.
the QCD sector of SANC is a very powerful and versatile tool for the theoretical predictions of the cross-sections and other observables for a large variety of processes at the one-loop level.
the SANC system has been successfully developed and applied to the calculation of the QCD sector of a wide range of processes of high energy physics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the QCD part of the system Sanc is ready for practical use.
we have implemented the QCD part of the system SANT.
the QCD part of the system is in the state of completion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SANC system can be effectively used to obtain the predictions for a wide range of processes in the framework of the Standard Model of elementary particle interactions.
the SANC system has been extended to include the one-loop QCD corrections to the processes of the production of heavy quarks in association with a gauge boson.
the QCD part of the system SANT can be used for calculations of QCD corrections to the cross sections of high energy interactions.
